title: New UK Loan Scheme Helps Families Upgrade to Green Energy
subtitle: Government-backed loans aim to make solar panels and heat pumps more affordable for households across the country.

summary.en: The UK government has launched a new loan program to help families pay for home energy upgrades. Households can now access low-interest or interest-free loans to install solar panels, batteries, and heat pumps. These upgrades are designed to lower monthly energy bills and make homes more energy-efficient. Energy suppliers are partnering with banks to offer these loans directly to their customers. While the new loans offer support, the government is also expected to reduce some existing grant programs for home heating.
summary.zh: 英國政府推出了一項新的貸款計畫，協助家庭負擔居家能源升級費用。住戶現在可以申請低利或無息貸款來安裝太陽能板、電池和熱泵。這些升級旨在降低每月能源帳單並提升住宅能源效率。能源供應商正與銀行合作，直接向客戶提供這些貸款。儘管新貸款提供了支持，但預計政府也將削減部分現有的居家供暖補助計畫。

paragraphs.en: Households across the UK now have a new way to lower their energy bills without needing to pay a large amount of money upfront. On Tuesday, the government launched a program called the Warm Home Loans scheme. This initiative provides interest-free or low-interest loans to help families pay for green energy technology. These technologies include solar panels, home batteries, and heat pumps, which are devices that move heat from the outside air or ground into a home to provide warmth.
paragraphs.zh: 英國各地的家庭現在有了一種新的方式來降低能源帳單，且無需預先支付大筆費用。週二，政府啟動了一項名為「溫暖家庭貸款計畫」的方案。這項計畫提供無息或低利貸款，協助家庭負擔綠能科技的費用。這些技術包括太陽能板、家用電池以及熱泵，後者是一種能將室外空氣或地底熱能轉移至室內以提供溫暖的設備。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian, the loans range from £7,500 up to £35,000. By using these loans, families can spread the cost of installing new equipment over many years. The government believes this will allow thousands of households to access clean energy alternatives that were previously too expensive. Miatta Fahnbulleh, the energy secretary, stated that energy must be affordable for everyone. She noted that these government-supported loans will help families make their homes warmer and cheaper to run without requiring them to pay anything at the start.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，貸款金額從 7,500 英鎊到 35,000 英鎊不等。透過這些貸款，家庭可以將安裝新設備的成本分攤到多年支付。政府認為，這將使數千個家庭能夠使用以往因過於昂貴而難以負擔的潔淨能源替代方案。能源大臣法恩布萊（Miatta Fahnbulleh）表示，能源必須是人人負擔得起的。她指出，這些由政府支持的貸款將幫助家庭在無需預付任何費用的情況下，讓住家環境更溫暖且運作成本更低。

paragraphs.en: Energy companies are playing a major role in this program. Major suppliers like British Gas and E.On have partnered with various banks to offer these loans directly to their customers. These loans are offered at a lower cost than those found at typical high street banks. Chris Norbury, the chief executive of E.On UK, explained that a recent trial in Coventry showed that customers could save more than £250 a year. These savings were achieved by combining a home battery with a special pricing plan, known as a time-of-use tariff, which charges lower rates for electricity used outside of busy peak hours.
paragraphs.zh: 能源公司在此計畫中扮演重要角色。英國天然氣公司（British Gas）和意昂集團（E.On）等大型供應商已與多家銀行合作，直接向客戶提供這些貸款。這些貸款的成本比一般商業銀行提供的貸款更低。意昂英國分公司的執行長諾伯里（Chris Norbury）解釋說，最近在考文垂（Coventry）進行的一項試驗顯示，客戶每年可節省超過 250 英鎊。這些節省的費用是透過將家用電池與一種稱為「使用時間電價」的特殊定價方案結合所達成，該方案針對在繁忙尖峰時段之外使用的電力收取較低費率。

paragraphs.en: For those looking to replace their old gas boilers, the financial support can be significant. A household could potentially secure a loan of up to £10,000 for an air-source heat pump or up to £35,000 for a ground-source heat pump. Furthermore, these loans can be used alongside existing government grants. Currently, some households can receive grants of up to £9,000 per year to help cover the cost of replacing fossil fuel heating systems with cleaner technology. The government estimates that installing a combination of a heat pump, a battery, and solar panels could save a household up to £550 a year on energy bills, with even higher savings possible if they use a time-of-use tariff.
paragraphs.zh: 對於那些希望更換老舊燃氣鍋爐的家庭來說，這項財務支持相當可觀。一個家庭最高可申請 10,000 英鎊的貸款用於安裝空氣源熱泵，或最高 35,000 英鎊用於地源熱泵。此外，這些貸款可以與現有的政府補助金合併使用。目前，部分家庭每年可獲得最高 9,000 英鎊的補助，以協助支付將化石燃料供暖系統更換為更潔淨技術的費用。政府估計，安裝熱泵、電池和太陽能板的組合，每年可為一個家庭節省高達 550 英鎊的能源帳單，若搭配使用使用時間電價，節省金額甚至可能更高。

paragraphs.en: However, the introduction of this loan scheme comes at a time when the government is also looking at its wider budget. The Guardian reports that the chancellor, John Healey, is expected to announce plans to reduce funding for the existing boiler upgrade scheme. This program has provided grants of up to £7,500 to help with the average £13,600 cost of installing a heat pump. Some officials in the Treasury believe that these grants have mostly been used by middle-class families who might not need as much financial help. While the scheme is not expected to be completely cancelled, it is likely that hundreds of millions of pounds will be cut from its five-year budget.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，這項貸款計畫的推出正值政府審視整體預算之際。據《衛報》報導，財政大臣希利（John Healey）預計將宣布削減現有鍋爐升級計畫的資金。該計畫此前提供最高 7,500 英鎊的補助，以協助支付平均 13,600 英鎊的熱泵安裝費用。財政部的一些官員認為，這些補助金大多被中產階級家庭使用，而他們或許不需要那麼多的財務協助。雖然該計畫預計不會完全取消，但其五年預算很可能會被削減數億英鎊。

paragraphs.en: Despite these potential cuts, there is still support for those in the greatest need. The Guardian understands that grants of up to £9,000 will likely remain available for households that are not connected to the gas grid. These families often rely on expensive heating oil and have fewer options for keeping their homes warm. By combining these grants with the new low-interest loans, these households may be able to cover the full cost of installing a heat pump.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管面臨這些潛在的削減，對於最需要幫助的族群仍有支持措施。《衛報》了解，對於未連接天然氣管線的家庭，最高 9,000 英鎊的補助金很可能會保留。這些家庭通常依賴昂貴的暖氣油，且在維持室內溫暖方面的選擇較少。透過將這些補助金與新的低利貸款相結合，這些家庭或許能夠負擔安裝熱泵的全額費用。

paragraphs.en: The list of lenders involved in the new scheme is quite broad. In addition to major banks, it includes organizations such as HTG Finance, Propensio, Secure Trust Bank, Selina Finance, South Manchester Credit Union, Sunsave, The Money Co-op, and This Bank. As energy costs have remained high over the last year, the demand for these home upgrades has reached record levels. The government hopes that by removing the barrier of high upfront costs, more families will be able to transition to cleaner, more efficient energy systems, ultimately leading to a more sustainable and affordable future for UK homes.
paragraphs.zh: 參與這項新計畫的貸款機構名單相當廣泛。除了大型銀行外，還包括 HTG Finance、Propensio、Secure Trust Bank、Selina Finance、南曼徹斯特信用合作社（South Manchester Credit Union）、Sunsave、The Money Co-op 以及 This Bank 等機構。由於過去一年能源成本持續居高不下，對這些居家升級的需求已達到歷史新高。政府希望透過消除高額預付費用的門檻，讓更多家庭能夠轉型使用更潔淨、更有效率的能源系統，最終為英國家庭帶來更永續且負擔得起的未來。

quiz.question: According to the article, what is the maximum amount of money a household could potentially receive for a ground-source heat pump?
quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。根據文章第四段，文中明確提到「a loan of up to £10,000 for an air-source heat pump or up to £35,000 for a ground-source heat pump」。選項 A 是現行鍋爐升級計畫的補助上限，選項 B 是給予未連接瓦斯管線家庭的補助上限，選項 C 則是安裝熱泵的平均成本，皆非地源熱泵的貸款上限。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the government's strategy regarding the existing boiler upgrade scheme?

options.A: The government plans to replace the boiler scheme entirely with the new loan program.
options.B: The government believes the current grant system has been unfairly favoring wealthier households.
options.C: The government intends to increase the budget for the boiler upgrade scheme to match the new loans.
options.D: The government is concerned that the boiler upgrade scheme is too complex for the average family to understand.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第五段，財政部官員認為現行的補助金大多被中產階級家庭使用，而這些家庭可能並不需要那麼多的財務援助，暗示了政府認為補助分配不夠精準。選項 A 與文章所述「not expected to be completely cancelled」矛盾；選項 C 與文章所述「hundreds of millions of pounds will be cut」相反；選項 D 在文中並未提及。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'barrier' mean in the context of the government's goal?

options.A: A physical fence or wall used for protection.
options.B: An obstacle or difficulty preventing progress.
options.C: A legal rule that limits energy usage.
options.D: A financial penalty for using too much energy.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在此文中，「removing the barrier of high upfront costs」意指移除「高額初期費用」這一阻礙，使家庭更容易採用綠能技術。這是一個隱喻用法，並非實體牆壁（選項 A）。選項 C 與 D 皆與文中提到的「成本阻礙」無關，屬於對單字詞義的錯誤延伸。

quiz.question: Which of the following best summarizes the main message of the article?

options.A: The UK government is forcing all households to switch to expensive green energy technologies.
options.B: Energy companies are now the sole providers of government-funded green energy grants.
options.C: The new loan scheme aims to make clean energy more accessible by eliminating the need for large initial payments.
options.D: The government is cutting all financial support for heating systems to save money for the national budget.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。全文的核心在於介紹英國政府推動的新貸款計畫，旨在透過提供低利貸款，協助家庭克服安裝綠能設備時「高額初期費用」的門檻。選項 A 過度誇大，並非強迫；選項 B 錯誤，能源公司只是合作夥伴，並非唯一補助來源；選項 D 錯誤，政府雖然在調整既有補助，但仍保留了針對弱勢家庭的補助，並未全面取消。
